entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: All right, bull! That's a new high score!
Bull?
You seem to know a lot.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: The center of the target's called the[n]bullseye. If you land a dart there, it's[n]called "bull"!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...I know because I looked up the rules[n]online last night.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Anyway, this game's called "01." You win[n]by getting your score all the way down to[n]0 points before the other player.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh, so you're not trying to get a high[n]score, but get rid of your score? That's[n]pretty different.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We both start with the same score, then[n]you lose points based on the number on[n]the board where your dart lands...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: And you can only win if you get your[n]score down to 0, exactly. You can't[n]even be off by a single point!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: How's that sound? Pretty sick, right?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So you have to be able to calculate your[n]score properly while making sure you[n]hit the right numbers on the board...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This game seems like it takes a lot of[n]concentration.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Heehee, one point!? C'mon, you have to[n]straighten your arm out more, and...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, Ryuji, what's up?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ah, I was just readin' this flier. It says,[n]"Darts is a party when you play in pairs!"

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You team up with someone and alternate[n]throwers when it's your turn. You still[n]use the same rules I told you, though.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, whaddya say we give it a try?
Yeah, sounds fun.
You better not tank us...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hell yeah, that's what I'm talkin' about![n]Let's do this!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Heh, look who's talkin'! I'm really gonna[n]show off my darts skills now!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Whoa! A bull right off the bat!? Man,[n]talk about an exciting opening!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Here goes! Don't underestimate an[n]ex-athlete!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: HELL YEAH! Triple 20!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Whoa, he hit such a tiny spot! Quite[n]impressive—especially for you, Ryuji.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We're almost down to 0 points! Let's[n]really focus for this last round!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Woohoooo! 0 points, right on the dot![n]Ain't we badass!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That's no easy feat! You really do have[n]something special going on!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man, this is so fun.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: When you're on the line, the pressure's[n]insane, but it makes you wanna do your[n]best for your partner!
I feel like I understand[n]something better after[n]pairing up with Ryuji...!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hm, based on the looks on your faces,[n]I'm guessing both of you got something[n]out of this game.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Even if it is just a game, it can be some[n]kinda training, depending on how you[n]play...
Someone's dedicated.
That's a good way to look at it.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Heh... Well, I do always have the[n]Phantom Thieves on the brain.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's keep practicing together here—[n]Ooh, ooh! Let's invite everybody next[n]time!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man... All this, just from me askin' you[n]to meet me here! This is, like... y'know...[n]one of those strikes of good luck!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: A "stroke" of good luck! Why would it[n]be a strike? Who would protest having[n]good luck?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ooh, what's that?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh yeah, they have pool here, too!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hmm... This game could be useful[n]too, depending on how we look at it...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's already pretty late, though. We can[n]come back and play it later.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Ah, and don't forget—we got a couple[n]free tickets to play today, but next time[n]you'll have to pay up.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But it was super fun, right!? I really[n]wanna play again sometime!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Well, we should head home for the[n]day. Thanks for hangin' out.
